title: Difficult operation, visibility, and access
summary: Reviews in this topic describe several usability frustrations, including hard entry and loading, difficult visibility, confusing controls, and BEV recharge inconvenience.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention difficulty getting in and out, seeing clearly, adjusting or understanding controls, exiting Apple CarPlay navigation, loading groceries, and needing to stop to recharge.

limitations: This topic mixes several different issues, including cabin access, visibility, control usability, cargo loading, adaptation to a different interface, and BEV charging inconvenience, so it is not a single coherent problem area.
Examples are short complaint fragments with limited context, so the exact component or scenario is sometimes unclear.
